# CANDIDATE: VWAP_RIBBON_ALIGNMENT_SHORT

**Filed:** 2026-09-09  
**Filer:** chef-nemotron (free-tier autonomous R&D)  
**Type:** new_trigger  
**Status:** DRAFT (NEEDS-RATIFICATION per Rule 9)

## Hypothesis

When price is below VWAP while the EMA ribbon is stacked downward (9-EMA < 20-EMA < 50-EMA), short-term mean reversion to VWAP offers a short edge. This condition captures intraday mean-reversion momentum distinct from existing ribbon-based setups that require price rejection at the ribbon.

## Mechanism

Entry: If price closes below VWAP and the 9-EMA is below the 20-EMA which is below the 50-EMA (all descending) on the same 1-minute bar, enter short at the bar’s close.  
Exit: Initial stop at the most recent swing high (highest high of prior 5 bars), initial target at 1R, runner trailed using Chandelier exit (ATR×3).  
Regime filters: VIX > 18 and time between 10:00-14:00 ET to elevate probability of mean-reversion.
